description: This file defines API endpoints related to budget management, including creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting budget entries using FastAPI. It interacts with a database to perform CRUD operations for budgets and includes role-based access control.

classes.name: BudgetNewRequest
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing the request body for creating or updating a budget, including fields like budget_duration, budget_id, max_budget, soft_budget, and others.

classes.name: BudgetRequest
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing a request to retrieve information for a list of budgets.

classes.name: BudgetDeleteRequest
classes.description: A Pydantic model for requesting deletion of a budget by id.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: A data structure used to send configuration options and current values for budget parameters.

methods.name: new_budget( budget_obj: BudgetNewRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles creation of a new budget entry, initializing the reset time if a duration is specified.

methods.name: update_budget( budget_obj: BudgetNewRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates an existing budget identified by budget_id with new parameters.

methods.name: info_budget(data: BudgetRequest)
methods.description: Retrieves information for specified budgets based on provided list of budget IDs.

methods.name: budget_settings( budget_id: str, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves configurable settings and current values for a specific budget, mainly used in admin UI.

methods.name: list_budget( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Lists all budgets stored in the database, accessible only to admin users.

methods.name: delete_budget( data: BudgetDeleteRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes a budget identified by its ID, with role-based access control.
